name: candor
description: Candour as a mechanism, not a pep talk. One blocking Stop gate, five clauses a script can prove: a file:line citation resolving to no file or past its end; a position retracted after bare pushback with no tool call in between; a completion claim after edits with nothing executed since; a task-runner run stopping without its recorded gate pass; a dependency map changed with an untouched lockfile. Flattery, apologies and defensive phrasing are counted by /candor:check and blocked by nothing, on purpose. Plus the terse reply mode (/candor:level lite|full|ultra|off): chat-message brevity as a shape contract — prose-line budgets and a fixed report skeleton, never less work in the turn.

cc_avert.title: Hedge guard mode (CC_AVERT)
cc_avert.description: Ask before a write or dispatch that carries a hedge the user never raised: on, notify or off. The environment variable CC_AVERT overrides this.

cc_candor_gate.title: Candor Stop gate mode (CC_CANDOR_GATE)
cc_candor_gate.description: The whole candor Stop gate: block, warn (print, never block) or off. The environment variable CC_CANDOR_GATE overrides this.

cc_evidence_gate.title: Completion-claim clause mode (CC_EVIDENCE_GATE)
cc_evidence_gate.description: Stop-gate clause for a completion claim with nothing run since the last edit: block, warn or off. The environment variable CC_EVIDENCE_GATE overrides this.

cc_lockfile_gate.title: Lockfile clause (CC_LOCKFILE_GATE)
cc_lockfile_gate.description: Stop-gate clause for a dependency manifest changed with its lockfile untouched: on or off. The environment variable CC_LOCKFILE_GATE overrides this.

cc_preamble.title: Working-moves preamble (CC_PREAMBLE)
cc_preamble.description: Inject the five working moves before the first edit of a session and of each subagent: on or off. The environment variable CC_PREAMBLE overrides this.

cc_terse.title: Terse reply level (CC_TERSE)
cc_terse.description: Terse reply level: off, lite, full, ultra, wenyan-lite, wenyan-full or wenyan-ultra. The environment variable CC_TERSE overrides this. A level other than off set with /candor:level also overrides this; /candor:level off clears only that level.

task_runner_stop_gate.title: Run-completion clause mode (TASK_RUNNER_STOP_GATE)
task_runner_stop_gate.description: Stop-gate clause for a task-runner run stopping without its recorded gate pass: block, warn or off. The environment variable TASK_RUNNER_STOP_GATE overrides this.
